title: Where All Answers Become Uncertain

features.name: question-that-fractals
features.desc-on-touch: A question that contains itself. Every attempt to answer it spawns two new uncertainties. You realize the shape of fear is fractal. It keeps dividing into smaller doubts.

features.name: ground-that-doubts
features.desc-on-touch: The paddock itself has begun to second-guess what it is. Is it grass? Is it planted? Is it wild? The earth has learned to be uncertain about its own nature. You're standing on a question.

features.name: sky-as-query
features.desc-on-touch: The high blue sky has become a question mark punctuating the landscape. Clouds form interrogatives. Every weather pattern is asking something it does not have an answer for.

features.name: certainty-undone
features.desc-on-touch: Somewhere, someone knew the answers to these questions. That person is gone now. The knowledge has scattered into the field like seed. Everything certain has become a crop of maybes.

inscription: certainty was always a kind of crop; when the season changed, when the harvest failed, when the method proved incomplete, the field learned to ask instead of insist

file.name: Manifesto_Fragment_Complete_Interrogative_1995.txt
file.note: A text that begins as assertion and devolves into questions; by the end, even the punctuation has become uncertain; ends with sixty-seven question marks in a row

exits.label: back toward the chamber where the fear still had a shape
toward answers that have stopped claiming to be answers
across the open country where every horizon is uncertain
